- Decision criteria you mentioned: cost per inference, data residency/SOC2 evidence, and integration time with your pipeline.

Next steps I propose:
1) Can you confirm who the economic buyer / budget owner will be for this project (title and contact)? That will help me tailor the commercial ask and timeline.
2) I attached a mutual action plan (Halo_MAP_v2.xlsx) and a short risk assessment (Halo_Risk_Assessment.pdf) - they outline a typical pilot timeline and the documents procurement usually requests.
3) If helpful, I can schedule a 30-min intro with our Solutions Engineer (Vivek) to walk technical procurement through SOC2 controls and data residency options.

If you can introspect to the budget owner this week, we can tentatively pencil a pilot start in late July.

Thanks - looking forward to continuing this.
